per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material packet remains separate from acceptance: XML/PDF/OA package and supplementary PDF/CSV were reopened, and material status remains material_extracted_with_gaps only because this is a packet provenance layer.

per_layer_decision_rationale.adjudication: The original full-source-review ticket is closed; remaining limitations are explicit cautions rather than open blocking rework.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP rows for beta-alanine, N-acetylated, homocysteine, cyclic, and dimeric constructs map to source values but do not fully encode source modifications in simple sequence fields.
DBAASP dimer records DBAASPS_14694/14697/14698 have empty sequence/name snapshots in merged rows; primary source table and scheme evidence preserve the dimer identities.
DRAMP32209 broad Anticancer label is not promoted; primary source supports no activity/no toxicity against THP-1 up to 300 ug/mL.
Chart 2 exact viability bar heights were not needed for publication-grade curation and were not fabricated; text-level no-toxicity conclusion is retained.

adjudication_summary: Worker-2 repaired Table 3/Table 5/Table S1 activity extraction, worker-4 reconciled linked DBAASP/DRAMP rows while preserving modified-sequence and database-only conflicts, and worker-6 completed source-reviewed adjudication as accepted_with_cautions.
